caption: Lovely spread of Knapweed, Hogweed and native meadow grasses along The Bog Walk (August 2025)
Beautiful Small Tortoiseshell butterfly feeding on Knapweed, with Yarrow dotted through the background (August 2025)
Small Tortoiseshell butterfly taking a rest on Knapweed along The Bog Walk (August 2025)

Male Common Darter dragonfly perched on the post-and-rail fence along The Bog Walk. You can spot these gorgeous red-orange dragonflies basking on warm surfaces all through the bogland from July to November (September 2023)
Bog Cotton in full seed along The Bog Walk with its beautiful white fluffy heads. A classic sight on healthy raised bogland and a great indicator that the wet bog is in good condition (June 2024)
Bog Cotton growing among Gorse and young Birch scrub on the raised bog. You can really see the lovely mix of wet bog, dry heath and regenerating woodland from The Bog Walk (June 2024)

Wild Dog Rose and Bramble flowering beautifully on a post-and-rail fence along The Bog Walk. These native hedgerow plants are fantastic for pollinators in early summer and produce rosehips and blackberries for the birds in autumn (June 2024)

Incredible Pale Tussock moth caterpillar found on a leaf along The Bog Walk! This striking bright yellow-green caterpillar with its mad tufts of hair is a native species. Great to see it here as it shows the insect life is really thriving (September 2024)

A Red Squirrel spotted sitting right on The Bog Walk path! Ireland's only native squirrel and a protected species. Such a treat to see one here, and a brilliant sign of quality woodland and hedgerow habitat in the area (August 2025)

Stunning Purple Loosestrife and Ragwort flowering in the wet meadow alongside The Bog Walk. The Purple Loosestrife really lights up the damp margins in late summer and the bees and butterflies absolutely love it (August 2025)

A lovely cheque presentation after our annual St Bridget's Day Clover Bog Walk fundraiser brought in €1000 for the village graveyard development. The Bog Walk has become a brilliant fixture in the village calendar, gets the whole community out and feeds straight back into local projects (May 2025)
